newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-MTK IN SIGHT OF LEAGUE AND CUP DOUBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MTK IN SIGHT OF LEAGUE AND CUP DOUBLE.

text.p: Hungarian champions MTK of Budapest virtually guaranteed themselves a league and cup double on Wednesday when they beat another Budapest club BVSC 6-0 in the first leg of the Hungarian Cup final.
Gabor Halmai set them on their way to a crushing victory with a close-range shot following a corner in the 13th minute.
Two goals by Bela Illes and one by Ferenc Orosz carried MTK to an imposing 4-0 halftime lead.
The champions were not so threatening in attack in the second half but still managed further strikes by Krisztian Kenesei and Emil Lorincz, who scored with a late penalty.
